ImageDescription.value: Slightly cropped and retouched (trash removal) portrait of Tomaž Planina, very likely taken in the Mačkovica cave, near the village Laze, Slovenia, by Primož Jakopin, around 1981. It was taken by Fujica ST 605 camera, equipped with Pentacon 100 mm f/2.8 lens at f 2.8, on Kodacolor negative film, illuminated by cable connected electronic flash, fired through the diffusion umbrella. Actual file was also made by Primož Jakopin, it is a photo of the original 10 x 15 cm photograph, from the time the photo was taken.
